changelog:
- Updated skill description to cover modern partnership types (creator, ambassador, B2B, gifting, FTC disclosure, seeding, whitelisting, etc.).
- Expanded guidance for both B2C and B2B influencer and creator marketing, with nuanced partner vetting advice and tier benchmarks.
- Added practical compensation benchmarks for influencer tiers and deal structures.
- Detailed deliverable negotiation tips (rights, exclusivity, content usage) and clarified content repurposing (e.g., turning creator posts into ads).
- Updated guidance for product/context file checks and improved cross-skill references for referrals, community, and ad creative.
- Added an evaluation JSON and replaced the skill-card with an improved SKILL.md format.
summary: When the user wants to run influencer, creator, or ambassador partnerships to promote their product — finding and vetting partners, structuring deals, briefing creators, disclosure compliance, and measuring ROI. Also use when the user mentions 'influencer marketing,' 'creator partnerships,' 'sponsorships,' 'YouTube sponsorships,' 'podcast sponsorships,' 'brand ambassador,' 'ambassador program,' 'creator program,' 'UGC creators,' 'B2B influencers,' 'thought leader ads,' 'gifting,' 'product seeding,' 'whitelisting creator content,' 'how much to pay an influencer,' or 'FTC disclosure.' For affiliate/referral payout mechanics, see referrals. For community-led advocacy, see community-marketing. For turning creator content into paid ads, see ad-creative.
